summary:
Apollo 11 was the historic American spaceflight that first landed humans on the Moon on  July 20, 1969.

Mission Overview

• Goal: Fulfill President John F. Kennedy's 1961 mandate to land a man on the Moon and return him safely to Earth.
• Crew: Commander Neil Armstrong, Lunar Module Pilot Buzz Aldrin, and Command Module Pilot Michael Collins (who orbited above in the command ship).
• Launch Date: July 16, 1969, from Kennedy Space Center using a Saturn V rocket.
